t.en: A statement that is either true or false is a proposition.

Whether the forecast is true depends on whether “it rains” and “the ground is wet” are. Each can be true or false, four combinations in all; one row per combination, with its result, makes a <wiki-ref to="truth"></wiki-ref>.
In “if X, then Y”, X is the antecedent and Y the consequent.

after.en: Logicians call this reading of “if … then …” material implication.

brief.en: The forecast says, “If it rains, then the ground is wet.” Decide whether it is true or false on each row, and fill in the cells.

hint.en: In which case has the forecast got it wrong?
On the two rows where it does not rain, has the forecast got it wrong?
